verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly position Devin to "repro and fix bugs". Sessions can start from Slack or Teams threads about bugs, Devin Review Auto-Fix fixes flagged bugs and iterates on CI failures, and MCP integrations such as Sentry and Datadog supply diagnostic context. Community evidence tempers this: early benchmark figures showed only 13.8% of issues resolved, and one demo fix wrapped a KeyError in a try-catch rather than addressing the root cause. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of reliable root-cause bug fixing, and in-depth documentation of the diagnosis workflow beyond brief mentions.
